selection.rule: three-day windows D0..D2 with no DST change in D-7..D2, every RT and DAM interval in the price history, and more than 3 days between every window day and every day of desk-v4-bench, desk-v4-eval and desk-v4-pilot; disjoint, the most windows per period, aligned to the strongest weather and notice fronts where the count allows
selection.unit: one task per operating day of a window (n_days 1)
selection.val: every day of the windows 2026-01-13, 2026-06-06, 2026-06-09 at all four sites (numpy default_rng(0): one of the nine Dec-Jan windows, two of the fifteen May-Jun ones)
